title: Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence
summary: In the summer of 1956, a small group of scientists gathered at Dartmouth College for the Dartmouth Summer Research Project on Artificial Intelligence, a research workshop organized under John McCarthy's leadership.
significance: A documented 1956 workshop in the formation of artificial intelligence as a field, following the 1955 proposal that named the project.

geography.note: Dartmouth's institutional history identifies the 1956 Summer Research Project as a gathering held at Dartmouth; Dartmouth's current AI history describes the gathering as taking place in Hanover during summer 1956.

verification.note: Year, workshop title, Dartmouth location/context and John McCarthy's leadership verified against Dartmouth institutional history. No exact start or end day is asserted because the reviewed first-party sources describe the gathering at summer/year precision rather than supplying a day-level event boundary.
